summary: Flexsteel Industries filed an 8-K reporting a privately-negotiated stock repurchase agreement with director F. Brooks Bertsch and family entities. The company repurchased 1,279,870 shares (≈24% of outstanding) at $47.00/share, a 2.5% discount to the April 24 close, for total ~$60.2 million. A special committee of independent directors recommended, and the board (with Bertsch recused) approved the deal. The repurchase closed on April 28, 2026, funded via cash and credit facility. The transaction is supplemental to an existing buyback program. Bertsch resigned as director concurrently. Watch for potential overhang reduction and future capital allocation decisions; no arbitrage angle as price was at a discount.
